description: This file contains validation functions for schema structural completeness within the Kubernetes API extensions server, including functions to validate value validation against schema structure, handling nested validations, properties, and additional properties.

methods.name: validateStructuralCompleteness
methods.description: Checks that all value validations in the schema have corresponding structural definitions.

methods.name: validateValueValidationCompleteness
methods.description: Validates that value validations have matching structural schema components, including nested validations.

methods.name: validateNestedValueValidationCompleteness
methods.description: Recursively validates nested value validations and properties against the schema structure.
